input: Find wildlife, birding, astronomy, aviation, environmental education and naturalist camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville wildlife birding summer camp 2026 kids
Pisgah wildlife education summer camps 2026 kids

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: 2026 nature-connection camps include Feathered Friends bird identification, nesting and migration activities.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: Week-long Discovery Camps explore nature outdoors; 2026 sessions documented, with 2027 dates forthcoming.

candidates.name: WNC Nature Center
candidates.note: Young Naturalist summer teen program ran in 2025; canceled for 2026, with no confirmed return date.

candidates.name: RiverLink
candidates.note: 2026 RiverCamp offered watershed exploration, aquatic ecology and river recreation for rising grades 3–8.

candidates.name: Growing Wild Forest School
candidates.note: Outdoor camps for ages 3–6 include birds, trees, insects, mammals, reptiles and amphibians.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offered six themed weeks of nature-based summer day camp in 2026.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 outdoor garden camp for ages 6–10 and CIT program for ages 11–16; nature, animals and cooking.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included Nature Nuts, an ages 6–8 adventure program exploring wildlife and sustainability.

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: Summer Science Camps ran June–August 2026; science programming includes exploration of the natural world.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: 2026 Movers and Shakers camp used weekly themes addressing community spirit and sustainable living.

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute (PARI)
candidates.note: 2026 middle- and high-school camps cover astronomy, astrophysics, space science and research instruments.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: 2027 enrollment open for nature-focused overnight camps and teen expeditions on a private wildlife preserve.
